title: 128쪽 · 3x HJ Open — CO Call — SB 3-Bet
sourcePageBasis: capture sequence, checked against surrounding folios
paragraphs: What eventually starts to happen here is all the scared money at the table starts min-raising the flop with top pair trying to end the hand early. Thats even better because it allows you to play with virtual clairvoyance. You ca" give up with gutshots and pile in with combo draws.

Then, the times that they call, they usually have some sort of draw or middle-pair-plus-gutshot type hand. The maximal exploit against this range is to overbet all blank rivers. It’s very counter-intuitive. Typically, you want the river to favor your range, but against this type of player it doesn't matter.
